messages:
maya: Uploaded the first draft PRD for smart routing fallthrough + prioritization. Need quick review on acceptance criteria + launch gates. PR link: https://go/repo/pr/2345
ashwin: skimmed it. main open q: how strict are we on variant compatibility? can we fallback between quantized and fp16 variants? latency + correctness concerns.
lucas: short answer: allowed only if architecture + tokenizer + KV layout are identical. quantized <-> fp16 ok if variant_id matches major arch and kv-cache layout. different training checkpoints (v1 vs v2) might change logits -> not safe. We need a versioned compatibility map.
sasha: ops notes: routing tiers = premium / reserved / spot. launch gating for MVP: canary at 1% traffic for 24h with perf SLOs met; rollback on error spike; runbook + run-throughs. Also need per-region capacity checks.
maya: added an acceptance-criteria snippet to the doc: ```
AC1: Routing decisions deterministic and auditable (route_decision event)
AC2: p95 latency <= tier SLO for 24h post-canary
AC3: compatibility matrix covers all model variants used in live traffic by region
AC4: automatic rollback if error_rate delta > 0.5% or latency p95 increases > 30%
AC5: no silent mid-session fallback that invalidates KV cache
```
ashwin: an important edge case: prefix/KV cache mismatch if fallback target has different pos-emb or kv layout. proposal: disallow mid-session fallback unless the fallback candidate advertises cache_compatible=true. otherwise do a session-level failover (return error to caller or re-request from client).
lucas: agree. also add a regression metric: token-level divergence and hallucination score. set alert threshold for production regression at +2% deviation on eval set. I'll produce eval prompts for the model pairs.
ops-bot: PR #2345 opened by maya: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2345 (CI: 42/45 checks passing, 3 flaky infra tests failing) :robot_face:
sasha: prioritization / customers: Acme Corp asked for cross-region fallthrough by EOY. If sales lock a commitment we should accelerate. PMs: can we scope MVP to 2 regions + 2 model variants per tier to reduce surface area?
maya: yes. propose MVP = us-west1 + us-east1, tiers = premium + reserved, allow only same-arch variant fallthrough (e.g., gptj-16b-v2 fp16 <-> q4 variants with same kv layout). Will update PRD with MVP scope. Can we get signoff by Friday?
ashwin: I'll add the compatibility matrix & unit tests. telemetry events required: route_decision, fallback_reason, cache_flush, variant_id, routing_latency_ms. Also capture pre/post token stats for divergence checks.
lucas: I'll run regression suite in staging and add a chaos test that kills a node to validate routing/failover behaviors. will share results by Thu.
sasha: :thumbsup: I'll schedule a deploy window and prep the runbook + rollback checklist. also we need an ops playbook for region capacity shortage.
maya: thanks all. if no objections i'll mark the PRD ready for RFC tomorrow morning. :eyes:
